runs.market_commentary:
Asian markets closed broadly higher overnight, led by Japan's Nikkei 225 surging +1.52% to 64,232 after SK Hynix's blockbuster Q3 results — operating profit of 83.33 trillion won (+632% YoY) exceeded estimates by ~8%, igniting a fresh wave of HBM/AI infrastructure optimism. Hang Seng dipped modestly (-1.6%) on ongoing China property concerns and profit-taking in tech, while Australian equities gained after CPI data came in below expectations, prompting speculation of a slower RBA tightening path.

European markets opened cautiously with the DAX adding +0.77% to 25,607 and the FTSE 100 declining -0.75% to 10,687. London underperformed due to GBP strength and a negative read on UK retail activity. Newsquawk's European opening wrap cited caution ahead of the Federal Reserve decision and MSFT/GOOGL earnings due after the US close, with energy stocks lagging as Iran-US talks weighed on crude. The Bank of Canada also has a rate decision today.

US futures point to a slightly positive open with Nasdaq-100 futures up ~0.35%, S&P 500 futures near flat to +0.1%, and Dow futures a touch softer. The dominant catalysts are today's Fed decision at 2 p.m. ET — Polymarket prices a no-change at 95.8%, with all eyes on Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference language on December — and MSFT/GOOGL earnings after the bell. Premarket standouts: VRT surging +15% on a massive beat, SKHY (SK Hynix US ADR) +8.5%, GEV +2.9%, and NXPI -8% on weak guidance. Consumer confidence rose to 91.7 (est: 82.8) yesterday, while the 10-year yield holds above 5% and WTI crude lingers near $101.62.

ideas.catalyst: Vertiv surged +15.28% premarket after reporting a massive quarterly earnings beat, signaling explosive demand for its data center cooling and power distribution equipment.
ideas.thesis: Vertiv is the pure-play critical infrastructure backbone for hyperscaler AI capex, and its revenue backlog continues to grow as cloud providers accelerate buildout. With the stock breaking out on high-conviction volume, momentum and fundamentals are aligned for continuation into year-end.
ideas.key_risk: Any guidance softening on supply chain or margin compression could reverse the gap up quickly.

sources.label: Morning Brief Oct 28: VRT Jumps, SK Hynix Beat

ideas.catalyst: DA Davidson upgraded Broadcom to Buy from Neutral with a $400 price target (up from $350), citing accelerating custom AI ASIC demand and strength in networking.
ideas.thesis: Broadcom's AI revenue line is compounding rapidly via hyperscaler custom chip programs with Google and Meta, and its VMware integration is delivering higher-than-expected cross-sell margins. The new analyst buy rating adds a near-term catalyst to an already strong secular story.
ideas.key_risk: Valuation premium relative to peers leaves the stock vulnerable to any macro-driven de-rating or AI capex slowdown narrative.

ideas.catalyst: Microsoft reports Q1 FY27 earnings after the close today, with consensus expecting Azure cloud revenue growth of ~34% and Copilot seat expansion driving meaningful incremental revenue.
ideas.thesis: Microsoft is the clearest path to enterprise AI monetization via Copilot, Azure AI, and OpenAI integration, and management has consistently delivered above-consensus results. A beat-and-raise on Azure growth guidance would likely send shares significantly higher.
ideas.key_risk: Azure growth deceleration below 30% or margin compression from AI infrastructure costs could trigger a meaningful sell-off.

sources.label: Stock Market News Oct 28 - Yahoo Finance

ideas.theme: Big Tech Earnings / Search AI + Cloud
ideas.catalyst: Alphabet reports Q3 2026 earnings after the close today, with the Street watching for Search revenue resilience vs. AI competitor pressure and Google Cloud growth inflection.
ideas.thesis: Alphabet's Google Cloud is accelerating toward profitability and Gemini AI integration in Search appears to be holding ad monetization stable; the stock has underperformed MSFT YTD and is set up for a re-rating if cloud results impress. Goldman Sachs maintains a Buy rating.
ideas.key_risk: Disappointing Search revenue growth as AI-native search alternatives gain share could pressure the stock significantly.

ideas.theme: Power Infrastructure / AI Data Center Electrification
ideas.catalyst: GE Vernova is up +2.85% premarket ahead of its earnings report today, with demand for gas turbines and grid equipment surging to meet AI data center power requirements.
ideas.thesis: GE Vernova is uniquely positioned at the intersection of the energy transition and the AI power demand super-cycle; its backlog in gas turbines is multi-year and pricing is inflecting strongly. The premarket pop ahead of earnings suggests institutional investors are leaning bullish.
ideas.key_risk: Supply chain constraints or a miss on wind segment margins could offset gas turbine strength and disappoint.

ideas.catalyst: SK Hynix reported Q3 operating profit of 83.33 trillion won (+632% YoY), crushing the ~77T estimate, driven by explosive HBM3e demand from Nvidia; US ADR surged +8.56% premarket.
ideas.thesis: SK Hynix is the dominant supplier of HBM (high-bandwidth memory) used in AI accelerators, and its supply is already contracted through 2027; the earnings magnitude confirms the AI memory supercycle is in full force with pricing power firmly in the seller's hands. Korean market Nikkei halo effect also lifts the broader Asia chip complex.
ideas.key_risk: Samsung's HBM qualification by Nvidia could erode SK Hynix's market share premium and cap further upside.

sources.label: Morning Brief Oct 28 - SK Hynix Beat

ideas.catalyst: NXP shares fell -7.96% premarket after reporting results that missed expectations on automotive semiconductor demand, with guidance signaling continued inventory destocking through H1 2027.
ideas.thesis: Auto chip demand remains structurally impaired as EV production targets are being cut across Western OEMs, and NXP's industrial segment is seeing parallel softness; the earnings miss breaks a key technical support level and sets up downside continuation. The stock is overowned by funds that rotated into 'safe' semis.
ideas.key_risk: Any unexpected pickup in China automotive demand or aggressive buyback announcement could halt the decline.

ideas.catalyst: Oppenheimer downgraded Enphase to Perform (from Outperform) today, citing persistent residential solar installation weakness in the US and Europe as high interest rates continue to suppress rooftop solar economics.
ideas.thesis: Enphase faces a multi-quarter headwind as installer channel inventory remains bloated and new installation rates have not recovered despite lower panel costs; the Oppenheimer downgrade removes a key bull on the Street and could trigger a wave of consensus estimate cuts. Rising 10-year yields above 5% further compress the NPV of residential solar projects.
ideas.key_risk: A faster-than-expected rate cut cycle or surprise upturn in California/European installation data could sharply reverse the short.

ideas.catalyst: Langenberg upgraded Boeing to Buy from Hold today, and the stock was one of Monday's notable decliners (-9.38%), creating a potential oversold bounce setup heading into the new analyst coverage.
ideas.thesis: Boeing has been beaten down on labor and production concerns, but the Langenberg upgrade signals that the worst-case scenario is now priced in; near-term delivery ramp on the 737 MAX is the key catalyst for earnings normalization, and the stock's risk/reward at current levels offers an asymmetric long. The upgrade from a skeptical analyst carries more weight than usual.
ideas.key_risk: Another FAA production halt or additional machinists' union disruption would invalidate the recovery thesis.

ideas.catalyst: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC to list on Nasdaq under ticker ANT, reporting $16.3B in first-half 2026 revenue; the filing lifted AI infrastructure ecosystem stocks including CoreWeave (CRWV) and Nvidia.
ideas.thesis: Anthropic's IPO filing is the most significant AI public market event of 2026 and will catalyze re-rating across the AI compute and infrastructure complex; companies with material Anthropic revenue exposure (AWS, Google Cloud) and GPU/HPC infrastructure providers (NVDA, CRWV) should benefit from the IPO roadshow hype and fresh institutional flows into AI. CoreWeave, as a primary Anthropic compute partner, is the highest-beta proxy.
ideas.key_risk: The massive $80.7B net loss disclosed in the S-1 could trigger a broader AI profitability narrative that pressures the entire sector.

sources.label: Anthropic IPO - Chartmill Stock Market Today

deals.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO Under Ticker ANT
deals.description: Anthropic, maker of Claude AI models, filed an S-1 registration with the SEC seeking to list Class A shares on Nasdaq under ticker symbol ANT. The filing disclosed approximately $16.3 billion in first-half 2026 revenue alongside an $80.7 billion net loss, reflecting massive ongoing model training and infrastructure investment.
deals.impact: High — largest AI IPO in history; will re-rate entire AI ecosystem

deals.headline: Proofpoint Agrees to Acquire Varonis Systems for $6.3 Billion
deals.description: Cybersecurity firm Proofpoint announced a definitive agreement to acquire Varonis Systems, a data security and analytics platform provider, in a deal valued at approximately $6.3 billion. The acquisition would combine Proofpoint's email security leadership with Varonis's data access governance and insider threat detection capabilities.
deals.impact: High — VRNS premium acquisition; positive for data security sector

deals.headline: KKR Acquires HOERBIGER Explosion Protection and Static Control Businesses
deals.description: KKR announced it is acquiring the explosion protection and static control divisions of HOERBIGER, a privately-held Austrian industrial technology group, in a carve-out transaction. Terms were not disclosed, but the deal expands KKR's industrial safety and hazard mitigation portfolio.
deals.impact: Moderate — incremental to KKR; positive for industrial safety M&A sentiment

deals.headline: Goldman Sachs Alternatives Acquires Majority Stake in Celnor Group from Inflexion
deals.description: Goldman Sachs Alternatives announced the acquisition of a majority stake in Celnor Group, a telecom infrastructure services company, from private equity firm Inflexion. The transaction underscores Goldman's continued appetite for communications infrastructure assets benefiting from 5G and fiber network densification.
deals.impact: Low-Moderate — further diversification of GS alternatives book

deals.headline: Penske Automotive Group Agrees to Go Private via Motown Acquisition Corp
deals.description: Penske Automotive Group agreed to be acquired by Motown Acquisition Corp in a take-private transaction, removing one of the largest US auto dealership groups from public markets. The deal reflects continued private equity interest in auto retail franchises with durable cash flow, despite EV transition uncertainty.
deals.impact: High for PAG; signals PE confidence in auto retail franchises

runs.market_commentary:
Asian markets closed broadly higher overnight, led by Japan's Nikkei 225, which surged 1.78% to 63,294 — its strongest session in two weeks as AI optimism from Anthropic's S-1 filing spilled into tech-heavy Japanese exporters. South Korea's Kospi outperformed, rallying 3.47%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng bucked the trend with modest losses. Brent crude held above $115.50/barrel on continued U.S.-Iran tensions, and the Philippine peso hit a record low past 64 per dollar.

European bourses opened in positive territory, with the DAX adding 0.91% to 25,411 and the FTSE 100 gaining 0.72% to 10,767. Sentiment was buoyed by the Anthropic IPO narrative and Meta Platforms' $97.5 billion capital raise announcement. Energy stocks provided a secondary lift as Brent remained elevated. The 10-year Treasury yield is down over 30 basis points in October, snapping a seven-month rising streak, providing a tailwind to rate-sensitive sectors.

U.S. pre-market futures are modestly green as of 8:30 a.m. ET: S&P 500 futures +0.23%, Nasdaq 100 futures +0.34%, Dow futures +0.21%. A heavy earnings slate dominates — Coca-Cola and Boeing reported pre-market (KO beat but saw weak North America volumes; BA results mixed), with Visa and Robinhood due after the close. The Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting begins today with a rate decision expected Wednesday. SoFi surged ~11% and Royal Caribbean ~6% in pre-market on strong beats, while Xylem fell ~8.6% on a guidance cut and Whirlpool posted a surprise adjusted EPS loss on revenue down 9%.
